hook: Your trash is sitting on the Moon right now.
title: 96 bags of human waste are on the Moon
description:
Apollo crews left about 96 bags of human waste on the Moon, along with boots, tools and cameras. They dumped unneeded weight so they could bring Moon rocks home. With no weather there, much of it just sits.

#Shorts #Moon #Space
comment_prompt: Should we clean the Moon? Yes or no
